title: Guardian Australia takes home two Walkley awards for excellence in journalism
summary_full: Stories revealing Pauline Hanson’s US trip with Gina Rinehart and the systemic betrayal of Kardell Lomas before her death recognisedGuardian Australia journalists have won two Walkley awards, one for a story about the systemic betrayal of a woman who was killed by her partner, and another for an exclusive story that revealed Pauline Hanson had travelled to the US with mining billionaire Gina Rinehart.Investigative reporter Sarah Martin won the award for print/text news report for her exclusive story that revealed the One Nation leader and her chief of staff, James Ashby, travelled with Rinehart on the mining magnate’s Gulfstream 700 on 27 October last year.
